facts.fact: The Cursor Start plan costs ₹649 per month.
facts.quote: Expanded access and higher usage limits for just ₹649/month.

facts.fact: The Cursor Individual plan costs ₹1,800 per month.
The Cursor Individual plan costs ₹2,273 per month if billed monthly rather than annually.
The Cursor Hobby plan is free.
The Cursor Start plan is available with monthly billing only, and annual billing is not available for it.
facts.quote: The Start plan is available with monthly billing only.

facts.fact: Cursor Start is billed monthly in INR and accepts UPI, credit card, or debit card payment.
facts.quote: Start is billed monthly in INR. You can pay with UPI, credit card, or debit card.

facts.fact: For UPI payments, Cursor Start renews automatically after the user approves a monthly autopay mandate in their UPI app at checkout.
facts.quote: For UPI, you'll approve a monthly autopay mandate in your UPI app at checkout, and renewals happen automatically.

facts.fact: Cursor Start is available to users in India, and availability may expand to select regions over time.
facts.quote: Cursor Start is available to our users in India. Availability may expand to select regions over time.

facts.fact: Individual and Teams plan pricing on the page is estimated at current exchange rates.
facts.quote: Individual and Teams plan pricing is estimated at current exchange rates.

facts.fact: The Cursor Start plan includes access to cloud agents, Cursor for iOS with remote control, and plugins, MCP servers, hooks, and skills.
facts.quote: Start adds more access to Grok and Composer models in addition to access to cloud agents, Cursor for iOS with remote control

facts.fact: The Cursor Individual plan includes unlimited Tab completions, while the Hobby plan includes only limited Tab completions.
Cursor's parent company Anysphere, Inc. states it holds SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and AIUC-1 certifications.
